args.summary: Following the deployment of v2.3.1, checkout-api began failing health checks in production. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed successfully; service is now healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the failed health checks is investigated.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api — found that v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production, while **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0 — rollout completed successfully.
3. **Verified service health** — checkout-api is now running v2.3.0, healthy, with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) titled *"checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions"*, documenting the failed health checks, the rollback, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause is investigated.
